name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2026-05-25, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
